name: avatar-group
description: Overlapping avatar row of the people involved: the first three faces, then a "+N" badge counting the rest. The people are the app's records, with the brief's names as the fallback.
provenPattern: A pure arrangement with no state or behaviour of its own, so it is a composition rather than a block (arrangement-only → template).

knowledge.purpose: Represents a group on one line with a row of overlapping small avatars and a "+N" overflow badge
useCases: Showing a task's or document's participants at the end of the row
Summarising members on a team card without listing names
Showing participants densely on the comment/like row
antiPatterns: Showing more than five avatars — the arrangement was built for the overflow badge; a crowd is unreadable
Making avatars the only carrier of identity — the name must also exist as accessible text
Avatars that look clickable but go nowhere
Guessing row field names — rows arrive with the source's own field names; take them from a sample the person supplied, the entity's declared fields, or the connector's documented row fields
Faces with no caption — a row of initials does not say whose group it is
The caption alone while the people load, then the faces pushing the row taller — while they load, three placeholder faces hold the row

placeholders.{{ENTITY}}: the app's entity type whose records are the participants (e.g. Member). The host that keeps the app's records serves them; without any, the fallback below is shown
placeholders.{{PEOPLE}}: fallback rows: [{ {{NAME_FIELD}}: string }] — objects of the same shape as the live {{ENTITY}} rows, keyed by the field names chosen for the field slots. Shown when the app has no records of {{ENTITY}} yet; [] for none. The brief's names may stand in; never invent people to fill it.

{{NAME_FIELD}}.description: the {{ENTITY}} row field holding the person's name (e.g. name). Take the name from the bound rows — a sample the person supplied or the entity's declared fields; never guess it.

placeholders.{{CAPTION}}: text.content — who these people are, in words, e.g. Platform squad · 6 members — the faces alone do not say it

mobileCollapse: Stays one row on a phone (keepRow): the faces, the +N badge and the caption never stack.
